title: Seismic Acoustic Impedance Inversion Framework Based on Conditional Latent Generative Diffusion Model
abstract: arXiv:2506.13529v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Seismic acoustic impedance plays a crucial role in lithological identification and subsurface structure interpretation. However, due to the inherently ill-posed nature of the inversion problem, directly estimating impedance from post-stack seismic data remains highly challenging. Recently, diffusion models have shown great potential in addressing such inverse problems due to their strong prior learning and generative capabilities. Nevertheless, most existing methods operate in the pixel domain and require multiple iterations, limiting their applicability to field data. To alleviate these limitations, we propose a novel seismic acoustic impedance inversion framework based on a conditional latent generative diffusion model, where the inversion process is made in latent space. translated_title: 基于条件潜变量生成扩散模型的地震声波阻抗反演框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.13529v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：地震声波阻抗在岩性识别和地下结构解释中起着至关重要的作用。然而，由于反演问题固有的不适定性，直接从叠后地震数据估计阻抗仍然极具挑战性。近年来，扩散模型因其强大的先验学习和生成能力，在解决此类反演问题方面显示出巨大潜力。尽管如此，大多数现有方法在像素域中运行并需要多次迭代，限制了其在野外数据上的适用性。为缓解这些限制，我们提出了一种基于条件潜变量生成扩散模型的新型地震声波阻抗反演框架，其中反演过程在潜空间中进行。为避免嵌入条件输入时引入额外的训练开销，我们在框架中设计了一个轻量级基于小波的模块，用于投影...
tldr: 提出一种在潜空间中进行的条件生成扩散模型框架，通过轻量级小波模块嵌入条件输入，实现高效且无需额外训练开销的地震声波阻抗反演。
en_tdlr: Proposes a conditional latent generative diffusion model framework that performs inversion in latent space with a lightweight wavelet-based module for conditional embedding, enabling efficient seismic acoustic impedance inversion without extra training overhead.
